columns.name: fencing_class

columns.reason: Static infrastructure classification held in the asset register.

columns.reason: Fixed site-access characteristic known in advance.

columns.name: asset_owner

columns.name: interlocking_type

columns.name: cable_route_class

columns.name: spares_kit

columns.name: maintenance_depot

columns.reason: Measures duration until the asset was returned to service, known only after resolution.

columns.name: trespass_risk_band
columns.reason: Pre-assigned location risk banding held before any incident.
